Dear [Miss Grigg](/person/586),
I send a few papers with many thanks to you for dispersing them. [Miss Adams](/person/15) and [her aunt](/person/1870) are arriving today, and in all the troubles of getting into their house this afternoon.

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
